Put an image of your Nuclear Strike CD (PC version, .bin or .iso) next to
nstrike.exe or into this folder, then start nstrike.exe.

At its first start nstrike installs the game from the image into this
folder, as the CD's installer would ("Full Install"), and checks that it
is the version this port knows:

  NUKEPC\         NUKEPC.EXE and the compiled game (compiled.bin)
  NUKEPC\data\    the game's data, its saved games (nukepc.sav)
  NUKEPC\video\   the videos

Afterwards the image is not needed any more.

The port's own settings are in nstrike.toml (also in the game: F10 and
F11), the gamepad's bindings in gamepad.toml (F12). Both are written here
at the first start.
